intro: LEGACY (.NET Framework 4.7.2 on Mono 6.12 + xsp4) and MIGRATED (.NET 8 Linux containers built from src-net8) were run side by side on identical seed data and every transcript in migration/baseline/transcripts/ (126 flows + 2 initial-state checks = 128 checks) was replayed against BOTH sides with migration/parity/side_by_side.py (direct legacy-vs-migrated diff) and migration/parity/replay.py (each side vs the recorded legacy baseline). Both apps were restarted before each app's mutating sequence. Nothing below is claimed beyond what these runs observed.
headline: MOCK mode (UseMockData=true, PreconfiguredData seed): 128/128 checks contract-identical, 24/24 full data-state snapshots identical in row order; replay.py vs baseline 128/128 on legacy and 128/128 on migrated.

MOCK mode strict (whole normalised response incl. error bodies + full Content-Type) 53/128 identical; headers 55/128 identical. Every remaining strict/header diff is classified below (D1-D7); none changes status, Location, page content, form fields, validation messages, JSON or /api/files bytes.
Before the src-net8 header fixes in this PR the same mock run gave strict 40/128 and headers 2/128 (F1-F4).

SQL mode (SQL Server 2022, UseMockData=false, both apps on the same database, reset before each sequence): 120/128 contract-identical, 19/24 data-state identical. Differences: S1 negative page (legacy defect), S2 EF6 validate-on-save (OPEN regression, WebForms SQL only; causes 5 of the data-state diffs and 1 contract diff downstream). /api/files byte mismatch in SQL mode was found and fixed (F5).
OPEN regressions: D5 (bundles unminified, non-functional) and S2 (WebForms SQL negative-stock create accepted).

Migrated tests: 176 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped. Legacy: no unit/integration test project exists; the 128-check transcript suite is the legacy baseline suite and passed 128/128 on legacy in mock mode.
environment: Legacy MVC: throwaway copy /tmp/legacy-mvc via migration/parity/legacy/setup-legacy.sh, xsp4 :5100. Harness-only edits (never committed): UseMockData=true, Views/Web.config System.Web.Mvc 5.2.3.0->5.2.7.0, Content/Site.css copied to site.css, Pics symlink for case-sensitive paths. msbuild warns it cannot resolve System.Web.Entity (unused; app runs).
Legacy WebForms: throwaway copy, xsp4 :5101, Mono compatibility edits applied by setup-legacy.sh (documented there).

Migrated: docker compose -f src-net8/docker-compose.yml --profile mock up (images eshopnet8/mvc:local, eshopnet8/webforms:local on mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0), MVC :5200, WebForms :5201. Container route worked; dotnet run was not needed.

SQL: --profile sql (mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest on :1433, migrated apps UseMockData=false). Legacy pointed at the same database by migration/parity/sql/setup-legacy-sql.sh (UseMockData=false, System.Data.SqlClient, Encrypt=False). Mono CONNECTED successfully.
Restart = state reset: mock -> restart app (fresh singleton); SQL -> migration/parity/sql/reset-sql.sh drops the catalog DB, then the restarted app's initializer recreates and reseeds it.
normalisations: Antiforgery / viewstate fields (__RequestVerificationToken, __VIEWSTATE, __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR, __VIEWSTATEENCRYPTED, __EVENTVALIDATION, __EVENTTARGET, __EVENTARGUMENT, __LASTFOCUS, __PREVIOUSPAGE): values dropped; fetched fresh from each side's form page before each POST.
Host/port: each side's own origin in absolute URLs (Location, links, img src, text) -> {base}.
Footer session info `<machine>, <M/d/yyyy h:mm:ss tt>` -> `<machine>, <session-start>` (machine name + session start time).

HTML is compared as a structured projection (title, visible text with whitespace collapsed and script/style/hidden elements removed, headings, links, images, tables, dl, forms, validation messages, assets); markup formatting is not compared.

Transport headers not compared: date, server, content-length, connection, keep-alive, transfer-encoding, x-aspnet-version, x-aspnetmvc-version, x-powered-by, x-sourcefiles, etag, last-modified, accept-ranges. Set-Cookie compared by cookie name only (values are random).
Absolute `Expires` dates (bundles: request time + 1 year) -> `<http-date>`; `Expires: -1` compared literally.

Contract level (CONTRACT.md parity rules) additionally ignores 3xx/>=400 bodies, Content-Type parameters, and bundle bytes; the strict and header levels do NOT, and their diffs are all listed and classified.
sql_limitations: The recorded baseline transcripts were captured in mock mode, so SQL-mode replay.py vs baseline is 102/128 on BOTH sides with the same 26 flows failing on each (SQL decimal(18,2) renders 19.50 where the mock renders 19.5 on WebForms; delete of a missing id is 500 in SQL vs 302 in mock on both sides; plus S1/S2/F5 flows). SQL parity is therefore judged legacy-vs-migrated directly.

EF6 seed scripts are referenced with Windows backslash paths (Models\Infrastructure\dbo.*.Sequence.sql); on Linux the legacy SQL setup copies them to literal-backslash filenames in the throwaway copy so EF6 can seed (harness-only).

Both apps share one database; reset-sql.sh drops it before each side's sequence and the restarted app reseeds it, so each sequence starts from the app's own seed. Seeds matched (initial-state checks identical on both apps).
SA password generated per run into an untracked env file (src-net8/docker/sql.env.example documents the variable); not committed.
tests: Migrated: `dotnet test src-net8/eShopNet8.sln -c Release` -> eShop.Catalog.UnitTests 68/68 (incl. Testcontainers SQL), eShopNet8.Mvc.IntegrationTests 68/68, eShopNet8.WebForms.IntegrationTests 40/40; total 176 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Build: 0 errors, 4 NU1902 warnings (AngleSharp 1.1.2 advisory in integration-test projects, pre-existing).
Legacy: no test projects exist in eShopLegacyMVCSolution / eShopLegacyWebFormsSolution. The transcript suite is the legacy baseline suite: legacy 128/128 (mock), migrated 128/128 (mock).
screenshots: results/screenshots/<flow>-legacy.png and <flow>-migrated.png for index, details, create, create-validation (client-side validation errors), edit, delete-confirm, webforms-list; captured in mock mode by migration/parity/screenshots_side_by_side.py with headless Chrome at 1280px.
